args.body:
• Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, making returns a major cost driver for retail logistics.
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%), showing that centralizing returns processing yields significant savings.
• Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin, making fast turnaround the key to protecting profitability.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and its companion piece at https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion
args.title: Bellwether 2026 Returns Analysis — Key Takeaways
